name: Gasgoo autosales model page (CPCA wholesale by model line)
history_from: 2016-01 (pages exist from at least 2016; older years not checked here)
how_to_parse: One page per CPCA line and month; table shows the requested month + 2 previous months + YTD (header 'Sep-2026|Aug-2026|Jul-2026|2026 Total'); first table row = the line. Parser: data_audit_v1/china_wholesale/group_0/gg.py parse(); fetcher: group_0/fetch_latest.py (cache, 2.5 s gap, stop on 429). '-' = no value. Page for a month not yet published returns 200 with 'No data available'.
note: Same source and line slugs as the 2026-10-10 CPCA unification (our China series = this basis). 2026-08 present on 2026-10-14, 2026-09 not yet ('No data available'). Robots allows /autosales/ (disallows only /api/, /_next/, /static/). Requires our series -> line slug mapping (exists for 617 of 677 series).

name: Gasgoo monthly brand article (CPCA wholesale; all lines of one brand)
how_to_parse: Index pages (3 pages/month) list ~110 brand articles; article table '|Ranking|Brand/Model|Monthly sales|YTD sales|MoM|YoY|' parsed by data_audit_v1/china_wholesale/group_1/fetch_articles.py. Rows only for lines with sales.
note: Text table only for foreign/JV brands (VW sample: 34 lines). Chinese brands (BYD sample) have no table (images only) -> use model pages. 2026-08 articles dated 2026-09-16/17, earlier than model pages are confirmed. Fewer requests: 1 page per brand-month.

name: Gasgoo segment ranking articles (SUV/sedan/MPV; by brand origin)
how_to_parse: Table '|Ranking|Model|Monthly sales|YTD sales|' top 50 per article; parser in data_audit_v1/round3/china_2022_08/fetch_rankings.py
note: Top-50 lists only (smallest listed SUV in 2026-08: 937 units) -> cross-check and slug discovery for new lines, not full coverage. Article dated 2026-09-27 for 2026-08.

name: CAAM (China Association of Automobile Manufacturers) monthly passenger-car brief
format: HTML with table as PNG image
how_to_parse: Article body is an image (file.caam.org.cn/....png); would need OCR. Content: industry and top-enterprise totals, not models.
note: No model-level data -> not usable for series; at most a market-total cross-check. robots.txt 404 (no restriction).

name: 16888 (Che Zhu Zhi Jia) model sales ranking
how_to_parse: Ranking table '排名|车型|销量|厂商'; per-model history at /s/<id>/
note: Already shows 2026-09 on 2026-10-14 (faster than CPCA model data) but since 2023-01 it is 16888's own RETAIL number, not CPCA wholesale -> different basis from our series; usable only as an early indicator, not as the value. robots.txt 404.

name: BYD voluntary announcement 'Production and sales volume' (HKEX)
how_to_parse: HKEX title-search JSON gives PDF link; pdftotext -layout; rows NEV passenger BEV/PHEV, commercial, overseas (export) total
note: Company total and powertrain split only (no model, no Denza/FCB/Yangwang split in Sep-2026 PDF). Cross-check of BYD wholesale total incl. export. hkexnews robots.txt 404.
